3 · Triage — after regions

The before/after picture: an arrow runs from each partitioned feature's global point to each of its leaves. Leaves of a good partition land right and down — more decisive, less heterogeneous.

What each partition buys — the gain in explained variance from applying that feature's subregions alone, on top of the global curves. Gains need not sum to the combined figure: partitions sharing interaction variance each recover part of the same pot, so the combined figure greedily applies only the splits that still improve it.
